title: Enterprise AI roadblocks and roadmaps, security and physical AI: Day two at TechEx
summary: Day two of TechEx North America explored critical enterprise AI challenges, highlighting the 'AI graveyard' phenomenon where pilot projects succeed but fail to scale in production. The conference covered roadmap strategies, security concerns, and emerging physical AI applications for enterprise environments.
problem_solved: Addresses why many enterprise AI projects fail to transition from successful pilots to production deployment.
why_valuable: Provides real-world insights into enterprise AI adoption barriers and practical strategies for scaling AI initiatives successfully.
